author: _Pv
body:
IGN: _Pv
Reason: Ban Evasion - NaSchulz. #629746
Explanation for this: My account _Pv belongs to me, I'm 18 so I have recently finished school and I decided to go travelling and was not planning on coming home for a long time, however due to some circumstances I had to return home sooner than I though, so I was in Thailand for 2 months. During the time I was away I was not planning to play Minecraft or return to it, hence so I gave my account to NaSchulz as it has many premium perks on various servers. Since I returned home after only 2 months I wanted to play a little again before I head off to Kenya in a few weeks time. 

It seems the confusion being NaSchulz has logged on my account from his home in Argentina during the time I was away travelling, and since I've returned home NaSchulz has been banned on his actual account (once _Pv was returned to me). You can choose to believe this as much as you want, however I would like to provide extra accreditation to this and back up my story. - Source -(Submitted 3 months ago)

All-in-all, no ban evading has been done, NaSchulz has not logged onto my _Pv account as I now own it again since he was banned on his account. 

If there is any confusion, let me know and I will give you some further information to clear it up.

Hope this is resolved soon,
_Pv.
